changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: A frozen holding refuses new positions (lots and contributions) while everything else about it stays allowed. Every existing holding is open to new money, so false is the correct backfill (issue #236).

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Expose frozen through both views. CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW only accepts columns appended at the end of the list, so frozen trails each UNION branch, and that keeps holdings_report_rows alive without dropping it. The report view merges same-wallet, same-ticker holdings that can disagree on the flag, so a merged row reads as frozen when any of its parts is.
